aspect: The approval rate, and its collapse
description: Patient permit approvals through Erez fell from 92.5% in 2012 to 88.7% in 2013, 82.4% in 2014 and 77.5% in 2015. In May 2017 only 47.2% were approved; the January-October 2017 average was 54%. It recovered to 85% by February 2023 and 81% in July 2023.
energy_note: Your odds depend on the year you got ill.

aspect: Denial is rare. Delay is the instrument
description: In May 2017, of 2,282 applications, 1,077 were approved, only 47 were denied - and 1,158, over half, were left without a response by the date of the appointment. Among them 255 children under 18 and 141 people over 60.
energy_note: Not refused. Just answered too late to matter.

aspect: A missed appointment is not rescheduled cheaply
description: The referral, the hospital slot and the permit must line up simultaneously. Missing one means restarting all three, and the disease does not pause for the administration.
energy_note: Three clocks, and they have to chime together.

description: Her oncologist referred her in March. The first request went unanswered, the second was answered in May for an April appointment, the third and fourth went unanswered. By the sixth the staging has changed and the protocol with it.
energy_note: A different cancer by the time the paper came.
notes: Constructed, but Gisha documents a real case of six separate requests by a young woman awaiting urgent cancer treatment.

aspect: The permit regime is a health determinant
description: Survival for time-sensitive disease depends on an administrative response time that is not published, not guaranteed and not appealable. It belongs in the clinical record and appears in nobody's.
energy_note: A prognosis that includes a government's response time.

aspect: EXAMPLE - May 2017, the month the system stopped answering
description: Of 2,282 patient applications that month, 1,077 were approved and only 47 refused - while 1,158, more than half, received no response at all by the date of the appointment. Among them were 255 children under 18 and 141 people aged over 60.
energy_note: Two hundred and fifty-five children, no answer.
